finalText:
Build's clean. 0 errors, exit code 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump changing option shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right key.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — threw on unset flags because the new config loader leaves them `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the wall of text (DEP01xx warnings, W1042/W2213/W3307, dedupe noise) is just the deprecation noise mentioned in the file's own comments — not causing the failure. Next: nothing, build's good.
